result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that appears mostly well-structured. Found 3 minor layout/content issues related to text truncation and card clipping in horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol...') is cut off at the right edge, with its name truncated.
issues.suggestion: This is expected behavior for a horizontally scrollable carousel, but ensure a partial-card peek indicator is intentional to signal scrollability, and confirm full names are visible when scrolled.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon styling is inconsistent between cards — the Tokumaru Ramen card shows a white heart on light background while the pizza card shows a heart on a dark circular background.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background and color across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.

issues.description: The 'Popular right now' pizza card at the bottom is partially cut off by the bottom navigation bar, showing only the top portion of the image and no restaurant details.
issues.suggestion: This is a scroll boundary artifact; ensure adequate bottom padding so full cards are viewable when scrolled into position.
